# ============================================================
# PRODUCT LINES
# ============================================================

## Off-Road Series
- Category: Off-Road Golf Carts
- Features: Lifted frames, all-terrain tires, heavy-duty suspension, brush guards, skid plates
- Terrain: Trails, mud, mountains, forests, rocky terrain, sand
- Suspension: 6-inch lift kits with heavy-duty shocks
- Tires: All-terrain and paddle tires for varied surfaces
- Protection: Brush guards, skid plates, reinforced frames
- Lighting: Integrated LED light bars, underbody glow kits

## Street-Legal Series
- Category: Street-Legal Golf Carts
- Features: DOT-approved headlights, turn signals, mirrors, seatbelts, windshield, VIN plate
- Compliance: Registered and road-ready, legal on roads up to 35 mph zones
- Safety: DOT-certified lighting, side mirrors, automotive-grade seatbelts
- Documentation: VIN plate, title, registration-ready

## All-Wheel Drive (AWD) Series
- Category: AWD Golf Carts
- Features: Power to all four wheels for maximum grip
- Terrain: Sand, mud, wet grass, steep hills, loose gravel
- Drivetrain: Full-time all-wheel drive system
- Performance: Maximum traction on any surface
